primitives.name: createProxy
primitives.when: Reach for this HARNESS-ONLY to run the front door: it terminates agent TLS, sees every request, and parks the ones a human must decide. It decides nothing itself; pair with the launcher for sandboxes and `sbx` for decisions.
primitives.fails: Throws synchronously on a missing `logFile` (or neither `certDir` nor `runtime`). At runtime, dead upstreams, malformed input, over-cap and timed-out holds all become loud logged HTTP errors, never silence and never a crash. A second proxy on the same port rejects `ready`, never crashes the process.

primitives.name: launch
primitives.when: Reach for this to HARNESS-ONLY start one sandboxed agent run: it creates the sandbox the agent lives in. It does not decide anything; combine with the proxy for the front door and the gate (M3) for policy.
primitives.fails: Throws synchronously on a missing/empty `runtime`, `agent`, `proj`, or `command`, on a bad agent name, on an over-long socket path, when `socket` disagrees with `<runtime>/socks/<agent>.sock`, or when `runtime` IS `HOME` or the project dir (its sockets could not be hidden from the agent). The child fails at runtime (nonzero exit) when `bwrap` or `socat` is missing inside, or when nothing listens on the agent socket.

primitives.name: run
primitives.when: Reach for this to HARNESS-ONLY run one sandboxed agent start-to-finish in a single call: it starts the proxy, sandboxes the command, answers holds, and returns the exit code with the ask and audit trail.
primitives.signature: run(opts: object) => Promise<{ exit: number, asks: AskRecord[], audit: string }>
primitives.fails: Rejects on a missing/unreadable `proj`, an empty `command`, a bad `mode`, a misshapen `gate`/`onAsk`, or a proxy that never becomes ready. The agent's own nonzero exit is returned as `exit`, never thrown.
primitives.example:
import { run } from "barebox";
const { exit, asks, audit } = await run({ proj: "/tmp/proj", command: ["bash", "-c", "echo hi"] });
